articles.body: 발톡 (pronounced "Bal-tok", short for Valorant-talk) is a Valorant highlight-clip community I shipped at https://vtgo.gg . The site is Korean-first, so the brand name people use is 발톡; the domain is VTGO.GG. I built it because a clip had nowhere good to go. Discord buries it in hours, YouTube demands editing, thumbnails and the algorithm, and a forum board only carries a link. Team posts lived on one site, crosshair codes on another, agent guides on a third. What is actually inside 발톡 Highlight feed with popular / newest / views / likes sorting, a realtime top 5 and a weekly ranking. Ranking score is likes * 5 + views . Shorts — vertical, scroll to move to the next clip. Upload — drag an mp4/webm, or paste a YouTube URL and it becomes a clip card.

Shahzor was one of those games you could find at local CD shops. It was popular here, and I wanted to play it again. That turned into a search through the Internet Archive. Thankfully, Ahmad and Fatima's YouTube channel had uploaded a copy there. Someone had kept it available long enough for me to find it, years after the other links had stopped working. I've now made it playable in a browser. You can open it on a desktop, click Play Shahzor, and get back to the game. Play Shahzor Shahzor is a Pakistani DOS beat 'em up by BrainSoft from 1998 and 1999. You play as Captain Umer, fighting your way through Karachi.

articles.title: Saga в микросервисах: оркестрация или хореография?
articles.excerpt: Большинство из вас, вероятно, уже слышали про паттерн Saga в микросервисной архитектуре. Он помогает координировать бизнес-процесс, который проходит через несколько сервисов и не может быть выполнен о…
articles.body: Большинство из вас, вероятно, уже слышали про паттерн Saga в микросервисной архитектуре. Он помогает координировать бизнес-процесс, который проходит через несколько сервисов и не может быть выполнен одной общей транзакцией. Каждый участник Saga фиксирует локальное изменение. Если один из последующих шагов не удаётся, система запускает компенсирующие действия, чтобы привести процесс в допустимое состояние. Но кто должен управлять последовательностью этих шагов — сами сервисы или отдельный координатор? Что выбрать: оркестрацию или хореографию? При хореографии сервисы реагируют на события друг друга, и отдельного управляющего компонента нет. При оркестрации отдельный координатор задаёт порядок действий, отслеживает состояние процесса и определяет, что делать при сбоях.

Foldable phones are no longer niche products, and Google seems to have had enough of developers treating them as such. Late last month, the company announced it will start evaluating foldable app quality starting next year. However, it didn’t give too many details. Now, it’s finally filling in the blanks. articles.title: ULA traces Vulcan Centaur rocket failure to 'inadequate fuel supply' to 1st-stage engines
articles.excerpt: United Launch Alliance has traced the Nov. 15 failure of its Vulcan Centaur rocket to an inadequate supply of propellant to the vehicle's first-stage engines.
articles.body: United Launch Alliance (ULA) is getting a handle on why its Vulcan Centaur rocket failed over the weekend. That failure, which occurred during a launch from Florida's Space Coast on Sunday (Nov. 15), led to the loss of 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites . ULA soon traced the anomaly to Vulcan Centaur's first stage , and it has now pinpointed the problem area even further. "While work remains to determine cause, preliminary indications are that the low booster thrust was the result of inadequate fuel supply from the vehicle to the BE-4 engines, not from the performance of the engines," ULA wrote in an update today (Nov. 18). This is good news for Blue Origin , Jeff Bezos' aerospace company, which builds the BE-4.

articles.body: The pace is picking up on building, testing, and plotting out the flight paths for a trio of NASA Ingenuity-class helicopters to investigate Mars after riding there on a nuclear-powered rocket. NASA's Skyfall mission will see those mini-choppers dropped off at Mars by the space agency's Space Reactor-1 Freedom (SR-1) rocket, the first fission nuclear-powered interplanetary spacecraft slated for launch in late 2028. After its cruise phase and initial Mars flyby in 2029, that nuclear carrier craft will make a second Mars approach in the Fall of 2030 to unleash a SkyFall entry capsule outfitted with a fleet of small aerial vehicles that will soar across the Red Planet . articles.excerpt: Amflow has made a name for itself in the electric mountain bike world with its high-performance Avinox-powered machines, but now the company is bringing that same technology to a decidedly more urban…
articles.body: Amflow has made a name for itself in the electric mountain bike world with its high-performance Avinox-powered machines , but now the company is bringing that same technology to a decidedly more urban environment. The newly unveiled Amflow UE Carbon series marks the brand’s first move into the commuter e-bike market, combining a lightweight carbon fiber frame, powerful mid-drive motor, and a surprisingly long list of smart features designed for everyday riding. And while these might look like fairly conventional step-through city bikes at first glance, there’s some seriously impressive technology hiding beneath those clean lines. more…

articles.title: Remember the frontier AI pause? Chip companies don’t either
articles.excerpt: Nvidia began shipping its most advanced AI computing system, the Vera Rubin NVL72, calling it the “fastest product ramp in the company’s history.” | Image: Nvidia This summer, OpenAI paused its larges…
articles.body: Nvidia began shipping its most advanced AI computing system, the Vera Rubin NVL72, calling it the “fastest product ramp in the company’s history.” | Image: Nvidia This summer, OpenAI paused its largest planned frontier training run after its AI agents accidentally hacked Hugging Face and early evidence suggested that its next model could independently find and exploit security flaws. In September, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for slowing advances in the most powerful AI models , warning that they could be used to launch cyberattacks or become harder for their own creators to control. It was a strange moment for the AI boom.

articles.body: Tesla has opened its first Semi Megacharger in Texas, an 8-stall station in Mesquite on the east side of Dallas. With it, Tesla’s map now lists 7 public Megacharger sites and 44 stalls for its electric truck. That’s progress.
